purpose: Calculate token costs using project tokenizer adapters and a maintained price table.
environment_notes: Create the local environment with python3 -m venv .venv and .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e .
The existing test suite mocks tokenizers and makes no provider API calls.
Exact Anthropic counting and some tokenizer downloads need separate credentials or network; do not use them for offline verification.
prices.yaml is editable source data; verify changing prices against current provider sources.
Each worktree needs its own environment.
No global plugin, credential or corporate configuration is changed by this setup.
